column3: Kuroneko Route · After School Encounter
What on earth did you want to ask me?
I'm sure you would know, since you took the time to listen to me after all.
Isn't that a given?
You sure are direct, aren't you.
Since I am accompanying you on such a senseless errand, just spare me the sarcasm.
Geez... whatever, I'll get straight to the point.
I'll ask you once more. Tell me the problems you're having.
It's not like I need to tell you anything.
Why are you still saying that? I'm worried about you!
What a troublesome person... It'll certainly be regrettable if I were to tell you.
Why is it regrettable? Who will regret it?
It'll be me. I'm regretting that I mentioned this in the first place.
...Hmm, it seems like you're being philosophical here...
Really? My speech and conduct are supposed to be easily understood, are they not?
What are you saying?
...I have chosen the most suitable answer to make you satisfied.
Aren't you trying really hard to sound sophisticated?
Hmm... that might be the case. But it doesn't really matter anyway, since you wouldn't understand.
So, won't you give up already?
No. I'm just getting started.
...*sigh*, I get your enthusiasm already.
So you finally understand.
Yes, it is simply reckless passion.
I'm totally being serious! I'm not being reckless!
If you don't retain your composure, it is the same. I said that I understood your enthusiasm, did I not?
However, this has nothing to do with you.
How does this have nothing to do with me if it's happening around me?
A fine argument.
But if you end up getting involved in everything, won't you be up to your neck in work?
Of course, there are priorities I need to handle, which is why I'm dealing with you first.
It can't have nothing to do with me if it concerns you.
...Is it because of your kindness?
Eh? What did you just say? I couldn't quite hear it...
...It matters not. Anyways, I ought to thank you since you're doing this for my sake.
I see... then, tell me...
But, I don't want to.
Why is that?
...Don't say it so coldly.
I mean it when I say that it has nothing to do with you. Isn't it because of your arrogance that you're feeling the coldness of my words?
Why do you think that?
Because you're just forcing your own feelings upon others?
How can I not worry if you start talking about something like that?
Also, it's only a waste of time if we were to continue on this philosophical topic.
Let's change the topic.
It'll certainly cause trouble for you if I were to tell you.
...Why would it cause trouble for me?
Because it'll hurt you too.
If that's the case, wouldn't not telling me anything cause me pain as well?
Aren't you just mindlessly getting yourself into trouble?
It's not like that, but it's really troubling.
Whether it's troubling or not isn't up to you to decide, it's for me to decide.
...True, what you have said is correct.
But since you already know about it, then why can't you understand that I don't wish to cause harm to you as well?
T-That's...
You've raised a bunch of one-sided theories, but those are more like irrational thoughts than theories.
B-But... isn't what's really important how one thinks, and not how one expresses himself?
Needless protesting... that's what best describes you.
Good grief... you just don't give up, do you. However, that's exactly the reason why I'm not telling you.
...Getting in the way... I didn't think of it like that way.
Hmph, I knew you would say that.
That's why you're being involved in various situations without realizing you're losing something.
Losing something, and what's that?
You're indeed a good person for not realizing it.
That's right, senpai is a good person, so if I speak up you'll surely...
No, I can even say definitely. You'll definitely get involved.
Are you saying I shouldn't?
Yes, if you don't understand the need to be reserved, then you truly are a selfish man.
Yeah, that's because I'm stubbornly nice.
I'm called nice because I persevere in my actions. That's why your convenience is irrelevant!
Wha...
....Yes, that's right, that's why I'm asking you to let me involve myself this time, too.
...Hmph. How many sighs do I have to make? Honestly, you're so...
Can't I be a good person?
There are times where a good person would be a bad one, however...
However? Aren't you the same?
Exactly, I wish this person could quickly realize that his good intentions are only a hindrance.
I don't get it...
How thickheaded... No, that's why I don't need this good person.
My, how I wish I could quickly end this torment with such a person.
I don't know what trouble you have exactly, but I can roughly feel how much you don't want to tell me about it.
But I'm not easily convinced. It's the same no matter how you hold me down.
This is not about others, but you! How could I treat it like it's some stranger?!
I wish you could tell me even if you were to feel irritated.
Could you please stop finding excuses to refuse me?
Although I don't know what else to say to request from you, but please, Kuroneko... Alright?
